subject: [hw] DEC07 start: RWVC_WIN_VDEC_ALL rev 3 text + kernel/fake patches
body: DEC07 starting. Deliverables: (1) include/redwood_vcodec.h rev 3 text for hw-lead: RWVC_WIN_VDEC_ALL = 12, base 0x16000000 size 0x30000, per-4KiB-page block (0x00000-0x1ffff VDE/VDEC_SOC, 0x20000-0x2ffff VDE2/VDEC_CORE), larb5 0x0d000 and larb4 0x2e000 pages read-only with a documented allow-list hook; (2) patch for kern/bsd/dev/nord2_vcodec.inc (to opus-kern/hw-k02): per-page block check in n2vc_op_window + POLL revalidation, EACCES when that page block is off, write/write-mask EACCES on the larb pages, nothing else; (3) patch for tests/hw/n2vc_hw_fake.c (to hw-t02): VDEC_ALL window + separate 0x30000 backing array + the same per-page power and larb read-only rules. My own tests under gpu/hwcodec/kern/test_dec07/** stage the patches onto copies in /tmp, run K02s suite on the patched file (must stay 588871/588871), add the new window/power/larb checks, and run the staged sweet_touch compile (0 unknown symbols). Host-only, no phone.
